% Canonical conditioning and claim-boundary statements shared by both views.
\providecommand{\SCIMapConditionalityStatement}{%
All linear expectation, response, and covariance statements are conditional
on fixed membership, projection, coefficients, support policy, response state,
geometry/WCS, calibration, and upstream processing state.}
\providecommand{\SCIMapClaimBoundaryStatement}{%
Algebraic contract correctness, engineering conformance,
representation/response fidelity, observational performance, and production
readiness are separate claims.}
